description: Source code for Vulkan runtime management in PyTorch, including instance creation, device enumeration, debug callback setup, and adapter selection.

classes.name: Runtime
classes.description: Manages Vulkan instance, devices, adapters, and debug callbacks for PyTorch Vulkan backend.

methods.name: find_requested_layers_and_extensions
methods.description: Finds and enables requested Vulkan layers and extensions supported by the system.

methods.name: create_instance
methods.description: Creates a Vulkan instance with specified configuration, including validation layers and extensions.

methods.name: create_physical_devices
methods.description: Enumerates physical Vulkan devices available on the system.

methods.name: debug_report_callback_fn
methods.description: Callback function for Vulkan debug reports, outputs messages to std::cout.

methods.name: create_debug_report_callback
methods.description: Sets up Vulkan debug report callback if validation messages are enabled.

methods.name: init_global_vulkan_runtime
methods.description: Initializes the global Vulkan runtime, loads drivers, and creates the Runtime object.

methods.name: Runtime::Runtime
methods.description: Constructor that initializes Vulkan instance, devices, adapters, and debug callback.

methods.name: Runtime::~Runtime
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up Vulkan resources and destroys the instance.

methods.name: Runtime::create_adapter
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Vulkan adapter based on a selection strategy.
